proof_body:
by
  intro p hf hp
  have h := IsCyclic.card_powMonoidHom_range (G := (ZMod p)ˣ) 2
  have hodd : Odd p := hf.out.odd_of_ne_two hp
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := (ZMod p)ˣ), ZMod.card_units p] at h
  have hg : Nat.gcd (p - 1) 2 = 2 := by
    apply Nat.gcd_eq_right
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hodd
    exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
  rw [hg] at h
  exact h
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)], p ≠ 2 → Nat.card {u : (ZMod p)ˣ // ∃ y : (ZMod p)ˣ, y ^ 2 = u} = (p - 1) / 2
